slider.question: On a scale of 1 to 10 — how connected do you feel to your partner right now?
slider.subtext: no right answer · only your truth

honestMoment.dividerText: This number isn't a verdict. It's a starting point.

segments.segment_1: Most people wouldn't admit this. You just did. That takes courage — and it's exactly why you're here. Let's start by being honest.
segments.segment_2: Most people open this app at a 5. You opened it at {score}. That's honest. Let's work with that.
segments.segment_3: Most people open this app at a 5. You opened it at {score}. You're doing better than you think — and we'll make sure it stays that way.
segments.segment_4: {score} out of 10. You're here because you want to protect something good. That's the smartest thing a couple can do. Let's keep it that way.
segments.segment_5: 10. Either things are genuinely perfect — or you're being very kind to yourself. Either way, we'll find out. Let's begin.

questions.prompt: When you feel disconnected, you usually…
questions.optionA: lonely because they're right there
questions.optionB: tired from trying a long time

questions.prompt: The last time you felt truly close was…
questions.optionA: longer ago than you're comfortable admitting
questions.optionB: hard to remember clearly — which tells you everything

questions.optionA: you stopped really talking — conversations became logistics
questions.optionB: you stopped choosing each other — it became automatic, not intentional

questions.optionA: you've tried — and you're not sure it's been enough
questions.optionB: there are things you could have done differently that you haven't yet

questions.optionA: this becomes permanent — that this is just who you are now
questions.optionB: one of you will stop trying before the other is ready

questions.optionA: this relationship has something worth fighting for
questions.optionB: you're not sure yet — but you're here, which means something

questions.optionA: you're not ready to give up — you just need somewhere to start
questions.optionB: you want to understand what happened before you decide anything

questions.optionA: fine on the surface — but not quite what it used to be underneath
questions.optionB: like you're both waiting for something to shift, without saying it

questions.optionA: in the everyday — the routines have replaced the real conversations
questions.optionB: in the emotional — you talk, but you're not sure they really hear you

questions.optionA: a low-level frustration that keeps recycling
questions.optionB: something you genuinely need that you haven't found the words for yet

questions.optionA: address it — even imperfectly, even messily
questions.optionB: let it settle first — you need to process before you can speak

questions.prompt: Compared to a year ago, things feel…
questions.optionA: comfortable — which is good, but also a little too quiet
questions.optionB: different in a way you haven't fully named yet

questions.prompt: What's getting in the way is…
questions.optionA: life — the pace, the stress, the endless list of things that aren't each other
questions.optionB: something between the two of you specifically — not external, internal

questions.optionA: to feel close again — not perfect, just genuinely close
questions.optionB: to feel like you're both choosing this — not just maintaining it

questions.prompt: You know it's working because of…
questions.optionA: the ease — things feel natural, comfortable, genuinely safe
questions.optionB: the growth — you're both different people than when you started, in the best way

questions.prompt: Your partner knows you love them through…
questions.optionA: the consistent small things you do without being asked
questions.optionB: the way you show up fully when something actually matters

questions.optionA: the depth of your conversations — more real, less routine
questions.optionB: the frequency of intentional time — more chosen moments, fewer accidental ones

questions.optionA: address it quickly — you've learned not to let things accumulate
questions.optionB: give it space — you've learned that not everything needs a conversation

questions.prompt: The inside thing you share is…
questions.optionA: a private language — references, looks, words that belong only to the two of you
questions.optionB: a way of being together that just works — hard to explain, obvious when you're in it

questions.optionA: the quality time — not letting life quietly eat it all
questions.optionB: the honesty — not letting comfort become performance

questions.optionA: building something — there's a clear sense of direction and shared purpose
questions.optionB: enjoying something — the present is genuinely good and that's enough right now

questions.optionA: something you grew — it took time and work and it shows
questions.optionB: something you found — a rare fit that you both recognised and held onto

questions.optionA: being completely yourself — no performance, no editing, just you
questions.optionB: being completely safe — knowing they're there regardless of what comes

questions.optionA: how much you need to hear that you're valued — not assumed, actually said
questions.optionB: how much you notice the small things they do — and how much it means

questions.optionA: come back to each other — the repair is always faster than the rupture
questions.optionB: stay fair — neither of you fights dirty, even when it's hard

questions.optionA: the way they move through difficulty — their resilience quietly amazes you
questions.optionB: the way they see the world — their perspective consistently surprises you

questions.prompt: The private question you carry is…
questions.optionA: are we growing in the same direction — or has the direction quietly shifted?
questions.optionB: am I being the partner they actually need — not just the one I think I'm being?

questions.optionA: the depth — the knowing-each-other that took years to build
questions.optionB: the spark — making sure comfort never becomes invisible to each other

questions.optionA: earned — you've done the work and this is what it feels like
questions.optionB: genuine — it's just always been this way and you're aware of how rare that is

questions.optionA: complete trust — you could say anything and know it would be held safely
questions.optionB: complete ease — being with them is the most natural thing in your life

questions.optionA: time — even at 10 the one currency you're always short of is uninterrupted time together
questions.optionB: expression — at 10 you sometimes assume they know things you haven't actually said

questions.optionA: you've navigated hard things together — the score reflects survival and growth
questions.optionB: you simply work — the compatibility was always there and you both knew it

questions.prompt: Your most alive moment together is…
questions.optionA: something new together — travel, decisions, adventures, firsts
questions.optionB: something completely ordinary — and it's still the best place to be

questions.optionA: you can't assume it — you have to keep choosing it
questions.optionB: it doesn't mean perfect — it means you'd choose this exact person in any version of your life

questions.prompt: Why you're using this app at 10…
questions.optionA: the best thing you can do with something this good is pay attention to it
questions.optionB: you want to know if your partner would give you the same number — and what it means if it's different

steady_flame.name: The Steady Flame
steady_flame.subLabel: Consistent · Deeply felt · The long game
steady_flame.description: You don't do grand gestures — you do quiet, consistent love. You're the partner who remembers what they said three months ago. Your relationship feels like a warm room, not a fireworks show.
steady_flame.growth: You assume they know. They might not. Say it out loud more.

electric_spark.name: The Electric Spark
electric_spark.description: You are the reason your relationship feels alive. You're the one who books the trip, tries the new thing, falls in love with your partner repeatedly. Your relationship has never been boring because you won't let it be.
electric_spark.growth: The spark needs to land somewhere safe. Make sure they feel secure, not just excited.

deep_current.name: The Deep Current
deep_current.description: You think before you speak and feel before you act. Your love is not loud, but it is deep — the kind that runs underneath everything else and keeps it all moving. People think you're reserved; your partner knows the truth.
deep_current.growth: Your depth can feel like distance. Let them in before you've figured it all out.

shifting_tide.name: The Shifting Tide
shifting_tide.description: You are the partner who says what nobody else will say — and somehow makes it land without cruelty. You've probably had one really honest conversation that changed everything. You're not afraid of the hard stuff because you know it leads somewhere real.
shifting_tide.growth: Honesty without tenderness is just criticism. The how matters as much as the what.
